observations: Single headlight assembly with a projector lens.
The lens surface appears cloudy or has surface oxidation.
The rear of the assembly, including mounting points, is not visible.
A watermark 'PUREGOLD GLOBAL' is visible across the center of the image.

Manufacturer stamps (e.g., Koito) are not visible to distinguish from aftermarket copies.
Photo resolution is insufficient to rule out hairline cracks or internal stress marks.
The mounting brackets are located on the rear and sides, which are not shown.

Close-up photo of the manufacturer's logo and part number molded into the plastic.

risks.risk: Internal electrical failure or moisture ingress
risks.proof: Video of the unit powered on and a photo of the rear seals.

proof_requests: Photo of the back of the headlight showing all mounting brackets and the wiring socket.
Clear photo of the part number and manufacturer logo molded into the housing.

response.reason: The specific vehicle model cannot be confirmed and the critical mounting brackets are hidden from view. Verification of the 'Original Toyota' claim requires seeing the part number or manufacturer stamp.
